newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end down slightly in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end down slightly in slow trade.

text.p: Shanghai B shares closed slightly down in slow trading on uncertainty over the market's direction, brokers said.
The index edged down 0.009 or 0.02 percent to 51.182 points, on volume of 7.7 million shares worth $3.6 million. Of 41 B shares, 36 traded, with 11 down, 15 flat and 10 up.
Brokers said that investors were cautious about building positions due to rumors that the exchange would restrict domestic investors from trading B shares.
"Most shares are very cheap, but investors are still reluctant to build postions on uncertainties about the market," one broker said.
"The index will fall further until some market factors become clear," a second broker said.
Shanghai Tyre & Rubber performed the worst, tumbling $0.020 or 7.99 percent to $0.230 on volume of 291,000 shares.
Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development traded the most, ending unchanged at $0.928 on volume of 1.2 million shares.
Shanghai A share ended down on cautious market sentiment due to a lack of a clear direction, brokers said.
The A index fell 14.121 points or 1.66 percent to 837.962 points on volume of 319.4 million shares worth 3.0 billion yuan.
The SSE 30 dipped 24.152 points or 1.10 percent to 2165.294 points.
Hainan Haisheng was the biggest loser on insitutional selling, falling 0.89 yuan or 10.36 percent to 7.70 yuan on volume of 9.4 million shares.
